text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should be non Chinese; for those who were Chinese citizens and then became foreign nationals, our University implementsNotice of the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China on Regulating the Work of Accepting International Students in Chinese Colleges and Universities. 2. Applicant should be in good physical and mental health (no infectious diseases, no physical or mental diseases affecting normal learning), abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as school regulations and rules of Xidian University, and respect China's social morality and customs. 3.Applicants for the master's degrees must have bachelor's degrees; 4. Language proficiency Applicants for English taught programs must have English proficiency of IELTS 6.5 or above, or TOEFL 80 or above, or Duolingo 105 or above.
